about_the_game:
AN INTRICATE MYSTERY

Worn Out is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel that follows a man moving into a new home—only to discover that things are not what they seem. Every decision you make shapes the story and leads you to discover more about your past, your present, and what’s lurking in the shadows.

ESCAPE OR FACE YOUR FATE

Your choices determine your fate. What you decide matters. Some paths can’t be undone, and each choice brings you closer to the truth—or to something far worse.

PIECE IT TOGETHER

Uncover the pieces of your past, the mysteries surrounding your new life, and the secrets you’ve buried. Each decision leads you closer to understanding—or further into the unknown.

BE TRUTHFUL

In a world full of questions, your answers matter. Be honest with yourself, or risk losing everything. Can you handle the truth? Or will you let the lies control your fate?

FEATURES

  • Completely hand-drawn pixel art

  • Narrative that changes with your choices

  • Multiple endings based on the path you take

  • Plenty of decisions that affect your journey—replay to uncover different clues and storylines

  • An unsettling presence who seems... a little too interested in your past

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent mentions and depictions of graphic violence, psychological trauma and similarly distressing content. Overall mature content that is targeted for a mature audience.

short_description: A presence lingers in the dark, waiting. It asks. It doubts. It knows. What happened? Why are you here? Do you deserve this? The answers are yours to decide. What you choose matters. Every path leads somewhere. But will you like where it takes you?
